primary_source_constraints: Git git-archive documentation: commit/tag archives use recorded commit time unless --mtime overrides it; tar archives can carry commit identity in a global pax header; tar.umask and Git attributes/config can affect archive output.
GNU gzip documentation: -n/--no-name suppresses original name and timestamp in the gzip header.
